parsed.reason: Description A says denied requests advance tokens via refill without updating updated_at, so repeated denied calls over-refill and the limit is bypassed. Description B says requests with cost greater than capacity can never succeed because tokens are capped at capacity. These are different failures at overlapping lines: one is over-admission from refill accounting, the other is permanent denial from cost exceeding burst.
